description: Change the price, size or stop-loss of an entry that has not filled: a resting limit order or a trigger entry. The new terms pass every check of a new order first; a limit order is then replaced (it loses its place in the queue), a trigger entry is rewritten. Use when the user moves an entry instead of cancelling it. Not for a held position's stop (use tighten_stop_loss) or take-profits (set_take_profit_levels). Inputs: order_id, symbol, venue, and price, size_base or stop_loss. Next: get_my_open_orders.
